meta.name: aws-device-farm-migration-skill
meta.description: Migrate test automation from AWS Device Farm to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers Device Farm desktop browser testing (create_test_grid_url) and mobile runs with test spec YAML, DEVICEFARM_* env vars, device pools, Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/instrumentation uploads. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from AWS Device Farm to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from AWS Device Farm, mentions create_test_grid_url, CreateTestGridUrl, boto3 devicefarm, DEVICEFARM_DEVICE_NAME, DEVICEFARM_APP_PATH, test spec YAML with phases install/pre_test/test, appium --base-path, 127.0.0.1:4723 inside a Device Farm package, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on AWS Device Farm, even without the word migrate.
